issues.description: Visibility of Animal.messageOnFeed() is inconsistent: the UML in the problem statement shows messageOnFeed() as public (+), while the reference solution declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This mismatch can confuse students about the intended visibility and may lead to inconsistent implementations (students might implement it as public following the UML, while the solution/test environment uses protected).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Either change the solution's Animal declaration to public abstract String messageOnFeed() so it matches the UML in the problem statement, or update the problem statement/UML to indicate the method is protected. Preferably declare messageOnFeed() as public in the abstract Animal class to match the UML and avoid student confusion.
